articles.heading: Itangwa ry’uruhushya Ikigo kitakira amafaranga abitswa gishaka gutanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
articles.text:
bw’ikoranabuhanga kigomba gukurikiza
ibigenderwaho mu gutanga uruhushya
biteganywa n’amabwiriza agenga abatanga
serivisi zo kwishyurana.

articles.heading: Kwemerera ikigo cy’imari cyakira amafaranga abitswa gutanga mafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
articles.text:
Ikigo cy’imari cyakira amafaranga abitswa
cyifuza gutanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga kigomba gukurikiza
ibigenderwaho ku kwemererwa, biteganywa
n’amabwiriza agenga abatanga serivisi zo
kwishyurana.

articles.heading: Ihagarikwa rya serivisi zo gutanga amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga Ihagarikwa rya serivisi z’amafaranga ari mu
articles.text:
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga ribaho mu bihe
bikurikira:
1º guhagarika ku bushake gukora
ibikorwa byo gutanga amafaranga ari
mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga;
2º kwamburwa cyangwa guhagarikirwa
by’agateganyo uruhushya cyangwa
iyemererwa;
3º iseswa ry’ikigo gitanga amafaranga
ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga.

articles.heading: Ingaruka zo guhagarika serivisi z’amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
articles.text:
bw’ikoranabuhanga cyambuwe uruhushya
cyangwa cyarusubije, gikora ibi bikurikira:
1° mu gihe cy’iminsi irindwi uhereye ku
itariki cyamenyesherejweho iyamburwa
ry’uruhushya, gisubiza uruhushya Banki
Nkuru;
2° gishyikiriza Banki Nkuru amakuru
shingiro yose yerekeye amafaranga ari
mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga,
inyandiko zose ziri mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga zisomeka n’andi
makuru y’ingenzi kugira ngo igire
uruhare mu kwishyura abakiriya
3° bigenzuwe na Banki Nkuru,
kigabanya abagenerwabikorwa
amafaranga ari kuri konti ihuriweho,
bigakorwa mu gihe cy’ukwezi kumwe
(1), kubarwa uhereye ku itariki
yamenyesherejweho iyamburwa
ry’uruhushya cyangwa itariki byemejwe
ko gisubiza uruhushya;
4° gishyikiriza Banki Nkuru raporo za
buri kwezi zigaragaza uko cyirimo
kwishyura; no
5° gihita ahagarika gukora ibikorwa
by’itangwa ry’amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga cyangwa igikorwa
icyo ari cyo cyose cyemewe giteganywa
n'aya mabwiriza.
Iyo habayeho guhagarika ibikorwa
hashingiwe ku bivugwa mu nginyo ya 6
y’aya mabwiriza rusange, ikigo gifite
amafaranga ahuriweho gihita gihagarika
ibindi bikorwa byo gukoresha ayo mafaranga
kugeza igihe Banki Nkuru igihereye
amabwiriza; kandi ishobora kumenyesha
izindi nzego bireba harimo n'ikigo kigenzura
serivisi z'itumanaho.

Haseguriwe ibivugwa mu bika byavuzwe
haruguru muri iyi ngingo, mugihe habaye
kwamburwa uruhushya cyangwa iyemererwa,
Banki Nkuru ishobora gufata icyemezo cyo
korehereza amafaranga ahuriweho mu kindi
kigo cyemewe gitanga amafaranga ari mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga.
Iyo Banki Nkuru ibonye ko bikwiye,
binyuranyije n’igika cya 1 agace ka 2on’aka
3
o
by'iyi ngingo, ishobora gushyiraho umuntu
ubifitiye ubushobozi maze agasaranganya
amafaranga asigaye kuri konti ihuriweho
y'ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga cyahagaritswe mu gihe
cy’iyamburwa ry’uruhushya.
Iyo amafaranga ari kuri konti ihuriweho
adahagije, abura yishyurwa ako kanya akuwe
mu kigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga cyambuwe uruhushya.
UMUTWE WA III : IMICUNGIRE YA
KONTI Z’AMAFARANGA ARI MU
BURYO BW’IKORANABUHANGA

articles.heading: Ibyiciro bya konti z’amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga Konti z’amafaranga ari mu buryo
articles.text:
bw’ikoranabuhanga ziri mu byiciro biri mu
nzego zitandukanye hakurikijwe uburyo
bushingiye ku ngorane mu bisabwa mu
kumenya umukiriya wawe:
1° Urwego rwa I: Umukiriya ku giti cye;
2° Urwego rwa II: Ibigo bifite ubuzima
gatozi;
3° Urwego rwa III: Intumwa
zikwirakwiza ibicuruzwa na serivisi;
4° Urwego rwa IV: Abacuruzi
baranguza.

articles.heading: Ibyitabwaho by’ingenzi mu gufungura konti no kugenzura umukiriya Ibigo bitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
articles.text:
bw’ikoranabuhanga bigenzura ko uburyo bwo
kwiyandikisha bubasha guha abiyandikishije
icyemezo cy’uko iyandika ryabaye.
Kwandika abakiriya bishobora gukorwa
huzuzwa urupapuro cyangwa inyandiko zo
mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga, umukiriya
agomba kuba gusa yemera amategeko
n’amabwiriza bigenga serivisi.
Kugira ngo habeho gahunda ya “Menya
umukiriya wawe” mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga, nomero y’indangamuntu
cyangwa nomero ya pasiporo y’umukiriya
igomba kugenzurwa hifashishijwe amakuru
shingiro y’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe
Indangamuntu cyangwa ubundi buryo
bwigenga.
Mu rwego rwo kurwanya iyezandonke no
gutera inkunga iterabwoba, buri wese ufite
konti y’amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga ahabwa ikirango kihariye
hatitawe ku mubare wa konti yafunguye.
Ibigo bitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw'ikoranabuhanga bigomba gufunguza konti
z'amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw'ikoranabuhanga z’abakiriya babyo.
Mu kugenzura umukiriya ibigo bitanga
amafaranga ari mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga
byita ku bisabwa bikurikira:
1° gushyira abakiriya mu nzego
zitandukanye nk’uko zigaragara muri
aya mabwiriza rusange;
2° kudafungura konti mu izina ritazwi
cyangwa ikigo kitazwi nyiracyo
cyangwa cy’igihimbano;
3° uretse kibiherewe uruhushya na Banki
Nkuru, ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari
mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
gifunguza konti zitarenga eshatu
zanditse ku mukiriya umwe;
4° kwemera no guha serivisi abakiriya
kimaze gusuzuma umwirondoro
wabo;
5° kudafungura konti igihe umwirondoro
wa nyirayo udashobora gusuzumwa
ndetse na/cyangwa
inyandiko/amakuru asabwa
ataboneka/atakwemezwa bitewe
n'uko umukiriya adatanga amakuru;
6° umwirondoro w’umukiriya mushya
urasuzumwa mu rwego rwo
kugenzura ko ntaho uhurira n’umuntu
wakoze ibikorwa by’ubugizi bwa nabi
cyangwa ibigo byashyizwe mu kato
aha twavuga nk’abagize imitwe
y’iterabwoba cyangwa imitwe
y’iterabwoba ubwayo, n’ibindi;
7° ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
cyifashishije serivisi zigendanwa
kigenzura ko ikarita igendanwa
igaragaza umwirondoro
w’umufatabuguzi na nomero ya
telefoni y’umukiriya byabaruwe kandi
bihuye na nomero y’indangamuntu
y’umukiriya.
Umuntu ufite imyaka iri munsi ya cumi
n’itandatu (16) cyangwa utemerewe gutunga
inyandiko yemewe imuranga ashobora kugira
konti y’amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga mu gihe cyose
umwirondoro w’umubyeyi we cyangwa
umwishingizi we ugaragajwe ukanandikwa
hakurikijwe ibisabwa mu byerekeye kumenya
umukiriya wawe no gufungura konti.

articles.heading: Ikoreshwa rya konti Uburyo bw’amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga bugomba gutuma umukiriya wiyandikishije abasha gukoresha
articles.text:
serivisi yifashishije umubare cyangwa ijambo
by'ibanga cyangwa ubundi buryo bwizewe
mbere yo gukora igikorwa icyo ari cyo cyose.
Uburyo bwo gukoresha konti bwifashisha
uburyo bwizewe bwo gukoresha ubutumwa
kandi bubungabunga ukuri n’umutekano
by’umwirondoro w’abakiriya.
Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga gifite inshingano zo
kubungabunga ibyerekeye umutekano
n’ukuri ku byereye ikoreshwa rya konti muri
rusange.

articles.heading: Amasezerano yerekeye serivisi z’abakiriya n’amategeko n’amabwiriza Ikigo gitanga serivisi z’amafaranga ari mu
articles.text:
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kigomba:
1° kugirana amasezerano yerekeye
serivisi z’abakiriya na buri wese ufite
konti giha serivisi;
2° gushyikiriza Banki Nkuru kopi
yemewe y’amasezerano/amategeko
n’amabwiriza yerekeye serivisi
z’abakiriya yifashishwa kuri buri
serivisi ihabwa rubanda;
3° iyo gifite konti itagikoreshwa
gukurikiza ibiteganyijwe mu Mabwiriza
rusange agenga ibyerekeye konti
zitagikoreshwa; kandi
4° iyo gifite konti y'abantu bapfuye
kubahiriza Itegeko ryerekeye izungura.

articles.heading: Ibikubiye mu masezerano yerekeye serivisi z’abakiriya Amasezerano yerekeye serivisi z’abakiriya
articles.text:
aba akubiyemo byibuze ibi bikurikira :
1° umwirondoro urambuye w’ufite
amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga n’uw’ikigo gitanga
amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga;
2° serivisi zitangwa mu buryo
burambuye ;
3° uburyo bwo kubungabunga konti
y’umukiriya ;
4° ikugaragazwa ko kugira amafaranga
y’abafite amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga bitabangamira mu
buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose ikoreshwa
rya konti z’amafaranga abitswe
yashyizwe hamwe zafunguwe mu
mazina y’ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari
mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga ;
5° ikoreshwa rya konti y’umukiriya
n’inshingano ye ;
6° imirongo ngenderwaho yerekeye
uburenganzira bwo kubikuza bw’abafite
amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw'ikoranabuhanga, harimo ibisabwa
ndetse n’andi mafaranga bishyurwa,
niba ateganyijwe ;
7° uburyo bwo gukemura ibibazo
bwashyizweho hashingiwe kandi
hakanagaragazwa aho ikigo gitanga
amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga kibarizwa.
8° ibisabwa n’uburyo bwo gushyira kuri
konti, guhererekanya, kwakira no
kubikuza amafaranga ;
9° uburyo bwo guhagarika
by’agateganyo cyangwa guhagarika
burundu konti cyangwa guhagarika
igikorwa ;
10°amabwiriza yerekeye itangazwa
ry'ibiciro bya serivisi ;
11°amakuru yerekeye uko konti zidakora
zicungwa;
12°amakuru y'uko konti z’abantu bapfuye
zicungwa ;
13° ahabarizwa umwe mu bantu ba hafi b’
ufite amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga, akaba ari na ho
hoherezwa imenyesha ko konti
y’amafaranga itagikora cyangwa
yahagaze mu gihe nyiri konti ataboneka.

articles.heading: Ibyerekeye kubika ibanga ry’amakuru y’umukiriya cyangwa umugenerwabikorwa Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
articles.text:
bw’ikoranabuhanga n’intumwa zacyo bigira
ibanga amakuru yerekeye serivisi giha
umukiriya cyangwa umugenerwabikorwa
wese.
Haseguriwe ibiteganywa mu gika cya mbere
cy’iyi ngingo, ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari
mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga giha gusa
amakuru yerekeye serivisi y’umukiriya:
1° umukiriya bireba;
2° Banki Nkuru;
3° uwo ari we wese, iyo umukiriya bireba
abitangiye uruhushya rwanditse. Urwo
ruhushya rukoreshwa rimwe ku
waruhawe gusa, bityo ikigo gitanga
amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw'ikoranabuhanga gisaba umukiriya
urundi ruhushya rushya buri gihe iyo
gishaka gutanga amakuru y’abakiriya
nk’uko bigaragara muri aka gace;
4° hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’itegeko;
cyangwa
5° bitegetswe n'urukiko.
Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga, kigomba kubahiriza
ibisabwa n’Itegeko ryerekeye kurinda
amakuru bwite n’imibereho bwite
by’umuntu.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa ku makarita y’agaciro k’ibibitswe Ibigo by’imari byakira amafaranga abitswa byemewe na Banki Nkuru bikaba bifite
articles.text:
ubushobozi bwo gukora ihwanyabwishyu ni
byo gusa bitanga amakarita y'agaciro
k'ibibitswe. Ibindi bigo bidafite ubushobozi
bwo guhwanya ubwishyu bishobora
kuzitanga ku bufatanye n’ibyo bigo bifite
ubushobozi bwo kwishyura.
Umubare ntarengwa w’ibikorwa
n’amafaranga ndetse n’inshuro zemewe
bigomba kugenwa n’ibigo bitanga ayo
makarita.
Ibigo bitanga amakarita byubahiriza ibisabwa
mu gufunguza konti bigenga ibigo by’imari
byakira amafaranga abitswa.
Ibikorwa byose bikorerwa ku makarita
y'agaciro k’ibibitswe byubahiriza ibisabwa
mu byerekeye amakuru byashyizweho na
Banki Nkuru ku bijyanye n’imyishyuranire
ikorwa hifashishijwe amakarita.
Ibigo bitanga amakarita byose bigomba
UMUTWE WA IV: IMICUNGIRE
Y’IBYATEZA INGORANE

articles.heading: Amabwiriza y’imiyoborere agenga ibigo bitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga bitakira
articles.text:
amafaranga abitswa
Iyo ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga ari isosiyete ishamikiye
ku isosiyete mbyeyi yashinzwe hakurikijwe
amategeko ya Repubulika y'u Rwanda, igira
imicungire, imiyoborere n'ibaruramari
byigenga bitandukanye n'iby'isosiyete
mbyeyi kandi yubahiriza ibisabwa ku
miyoborere y’ikigo by’ingenzi byashyizweho
na Banki Nkuru.
Ibisabwa biteganyijwe mu gika cya mbere
cy’iyi ngingo ntibishobora kubuza isosiyeti
mbyeyi guhagararirwa mu nama y’ubutegetse
no gushyira raporo z’imikoreshereze y’imari
y’isosiyete iyishamikiyeho muri raporo
z’imikoreshereze y’imari yayo.
Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga kigomba gushyiraho
imiyoborore ihamye, ikorera mu mucyo kandi
ikwiye kugira ngo serivisi zacyo zikomeze
kuba ntamakemwa.
Imiterere y’imiyoborere igaragara mu gika
cya kabiri cy’iyi ngingo iba ikubiyemo:
1° amabwiriza yerekeye imiyoborere,
urugero amakuru yerekeye ba
nyir’ikigo n’imiterere y’imiyoborere;
2° gutandukanya inshingano
n’amabwiriza yerekeye ingamba mu
bugenzuzi mu rwego rwo kugabanya
ibyatuma habaho imicungire mibi
ndetse n’uburiganya;
3° isosiyete mbyeyi y’ikigo gitanga
amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga cyangwa ikigo
gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga ubwacyo
ntibyemerewe gukora nk’intumwa
z’ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga;
4° itandukaniro rikwiye hagati yo
gutunga no gucunga ikigo gitanga
amafanga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga, abanyamigabane
bafite uruhare rugaragara
ntibashobora gufata umwanya
w’ubuyobozi bukuru.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga gikora indi mirimo itari gutanga serivisi zo kwishyurana
articles.text:
Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga gikora indi mirimo itari
gutanga serivisi zo kwishyurana, kigomba:
1° gushyiraho mu nzego z’imiyoborere
y’ikigo, urwego rwihariye rushinzwe
itangwa rya serivisi zo kwishyurana.
Hakubiyemo kandi gutandukanya
ibitabo by’ibaruramari byerekeranye
no gutanga serivisi zo kwishyurana
n’ibindi bitabo ndetse no
gutandukanya raporo z’ibaruramari;
2° gukora ku buryo ishami ryihariye
rishinzwe itangwa rya serivisi zo
kwishyurana rigenzurwa mu buryo
butaziguye n’urwego rukuru mu kigo;
3° no gusabira kwemerwa na Banki
Nkuru abagize ubuyobozi bw’ishami
rishinzwe itangwa rya serivisi zo
kwishyurana. Ibaruwa isaba
iherekezwa n’inyandiko igaragaza
ubunyangamugayo nk’uko
biteganyijwe mu mabwiriza agenga
abatanga serivisi zo kwishyurana.
Inyandiko yuzuzwa neza n’abagize
komite nyobozi y’ishami ryihariye
rishinzwe itangwa rya serivisi zo
kwishyurana.
Mu gihe utanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga akora n’ibindi bikorwa
bitari serivisi yo kwishyurana abona ko ari
ngombwa gushinga sosiyete yihariye kugira
ngo atange ibikorwa bya serivisi yo
kwishyurana gusa, utanga amafaranga ari mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga asaba Banki Nkuru
gutandukanya serivisi yo gutanga amafaranga
ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga n’ubundi
bucuruzi.
Usaba agomba kuzirikana ibikenerwa byose
mu gutanga uruhushya hakurikije amabwiriza
rusange agenga abatanga serivisi zo
kwishyurana.

articles.heading: Inshingano z’inama y’ubutegetsi Hatabangamiwe inshingano z’inama y’ubutegetsi ziteganyijwe mu itegeko rigenga
articles.text:
amasosiyete, inama y’ubutegetsi y’ikigo
gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga, yubahiriza inshingano
ziteganywa n’aya mabwiriza rusange.
Inama y’ubutegetsi ifite muri rusange
inshingano yo guteza imbere iterambere
rirambye n’imari y’ikigo gitanga amafaranga
ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga.
Mu kuzuza iyi nshingano, inama y’ubutegetsi
igomba:
1° kwemeza ingano y’ibyateza ingorane,
gahunda z’ibikorwa n’ibindi
bishobora guteza ingaruka zikomeye
ku miterere y’ibyateza ingorane
by’ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga;
2° kugenzura uko umuyobozi mukuru
n’ubuyobozi bukuru butoranywa,
imikorere yabwo, uko ababugize
bahembwa n’uko basimburana ku
myanya, hashyirwaho ibipimo
bikwiye by’ubunyangamugayo
n’ubushobozi, kugira ngo bayobore
neza imirimo y’ikigo gitanga
amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga;
3° kugenzura ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya
gahunda y’imiyoborere na politiki
y’ubugenzuzi bw’imbere mu bigo
bitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga, no gukora
isuzuma mu buryo buhoraho kugira
ngo harebwe niba hari impinduka
zifatika z’imirimo y’ikigo gitanga
amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga;
4° guteza imbere umuco mwiza mu kigo
gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga, ushimangira
imyitwarire n’imyifatire ishingiye ku
muco mwiza, ku bushishozi
n’ubunyamwuga;
5° kugenzura no kwemeza gahunda yo
gukomeza ibikorwa ndetse na
gahunda yo kubisohokamo no
kwemeza ko izo gahunda
zivugururwa;
6° gushyiraho komite z’inama
y’ubutegetsi zunganira inama
y’ubutegetsi gushyira mu bikorwa
inshingano zayo;
7° kumenya neza inyungu zisigara cyane
cyane ko isosiyeti izajya ibika
amafaranga ahuriweho mu izina
ry’abafite amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga;
8° kugenzura imicungire myiza
y’amafaranga ahuriweho mu:
i. kugirana amasezerano yerekeye konti
ihuriweho na banki cyangwa ikigo
cy’imari iciriritse cyakira amafaranga
abitswa kibitse amafaranga ahuriweho;
ii. kubika inyandiko ku makuru
arambuye ya ba nyiri konti
z’amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga nk’uko bisabwa
na Banki Nkuru ku byerekeye konti
zihuriweho. Izo nyandiko zivugwa
muri aka gace zigomba kuba
zikubiyemo nibura umwirondoro
n’umubare w’amafaranga yose
ahurizwa hamwe buri munsi bya buri
wese mu bafite konti z’amafaranga ari
mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga abikiwe
mu kigo kibitse amafaranga
ahuriweho;
iii. gushyikiriza izo nyandiko ikigo
kibitsemo amafaranga ahuriweho, buri
munsi;
iv. gutanga inyandiko isabwa yemeza ko
inyandiko zatanzwe ziteganywa mu
gace (3) k’iki gika ari ukuri, igihe
bisabwe n’ikigo kibitse amafaranga
ahuriweho.
v. kugenzura neza ibaruramari
n’itangazwa ry’amafaranga ahuriweho
bikurikije uburyo bw’ibaruramari
n’itangazwa buvugwa muri aya
mabwiriza.

articles.heading: Ishyirwaho rya komite z’inama y’ubutegetsi Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kitakira amafaranga
articles.text:
abitswa, kigomba gushyiraho nibura komite
zikurikira:
1° Komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi
ishinzwe ubugenzuzi;
2° komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe
gucunga ibyateza ingorane.
Haseguriwe ibivugwa mu gika cya mbere
cy’iyi ngingo, ishyirwaho rya za komite
z’inama y’ubutegetsi zishingira ku cyiciro
utanga serivisi z’amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga arimo nk’uko
biteganywa n’amabwiriza rusange agenga
abatanga serisivi zo kwishyurana.

articles.heading: Inshingano za komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe ubugenzuzi Komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe
articles.text:
ubugenzuzi igomba:
1° Gutanga buri mwaka raporo y’imari
yagenzuwe harimo na konti
zihuriweho;
2° Kunganira inama y’ubutegetsi kugira
ngo harebwe niba hari uburyo
bwizewe kandi bunyuze mu mucyo
bwo gutanga raporo y’imari mu kigo
gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga;
3° Kugenzura ubushobozi
bw’ubugenzuzi bw’imbere mu kigo
gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga mu:
i. gusuzuma no kwemeza gahunda
y’ubugenzuzi, abarebwa na bwo,
uburyo n’inshuro buzakorwa;
ii. gusuzuma raporo z’ubugenzuzi,
harimo raporo z’amafaranga
ahuriweho no kwemeza ko
ubuyobozi bukuru bufata ingamba
zikosora zikwiriye mu gihe
gikwiriye kugira ngo hakemurwe
ibibazo bituruka ku ntege nke zo
kugenzura, kutubahiriza
amategeko, politiki n’ibindi
bibazo bigaragazwa n’ubugenzuzi
bw’imbere n’indi mirimo yo
kugenzura;
iii. gushyiraho uburyo bwo gusuzuma
imikorere n’ubushobozi
bw’imikorere y’ubugenzuzi
bw’imbere;
iv. no kugenzura neza ko amafaranga
ahuriweho n’amafaranga y’ikigo
gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga
bitandukanywa.

articles.heading: Inshingano za komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe gucunga ibyateza ingorane Komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe
articles.text:
gucunga ibyateza ingorane igomba:
1° kunganira inama y’ubutegetsi mu
kugenzura ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya
gahunda yo gucunga ibyateza
ingorane by’ibigo bitanga amafaranga
ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga;
2° kugena inshingano z’umurimo wo
gucunga ibyateza ingorane by’ikigo
gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga;
3° kugira inama, inama y’ubutegetsi ku
byerekeye ibyateza ingorane by’ubu
n’ibizaza mu bigo bitanga amafaranga
ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga,
kugenzura uko ubuyobozi bukuru
bushyira mu bikorwa politiki zo
gucunga ibyateza ingorane, gutanga
raporo ku miterere y’umuco
w’ibyateza ingorane mu bigo bitanga
amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga, gukorana no
kugenzura umuyobozi ushinzwe
gucunga ibyateza ingorane;
4° gushyiraho uburyo bwiza
bw’imicungire y’amafaranga.

articles.heading: Imyitwarire y’abagize inama y’ubutegetsi Mu gihe abagize inama y’ubutegetsi bashyira mu bikorwa inshingano zabo bagomba
articles.text:
1° gukora gusa ku bw’inyungu
z’abagenerwabikorwa;
2° kwirinda amakimbirane ashingiye ku
nyungu ayo ari yo yose hagati
y’inyungu zabo bwite
n’iz’abagenerwabikorwa;
3° kwirinda kubona inyungu ziturutse ku
mutungo ucunzwe nabo ubwabo
keretse mu gihe amasezarano yo
gucunga iby’abandi abyemera;
4° bakora ibikorwa bya konti ihuriweho
nk’uko undi muntu ushishoza yakora
ibikorwa bye bwite;
5° kwirinda guha ububasha bwabo
abandi bantu usibye mu bijyane
n’ubuyobozi aho umuntu ushishoza
yakohereza umuhagararira;
6° kwirinda gutonesha
umugenerwabikorwa kurusha undi.

articles.heading: Ibigenderwaho mu gusuzuma niba abagize inama y’ubutegetsi babikwiriye
articles.text:
Mu gihe ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga cyashyiriweho
gutanga serivisi zo kwishyurana gusa, inama
y’ubutegetsi igomba kuba igizwe n’abantu
bafite ubunararibonye, bafitiwe icyizere,
barangwa n’ubunyangamugayo, bafite
ubumenyi buhagije, bafite ubumenyi
bwuzuzanya, n’ubuhanga kandi bagomba
kuba barize amashuri akenewe.
Abagize inama y’ubutegetsi bagomba kuba
bujuje ibisabwa bijyanye
n’ubunyangamugayo n’ ubushobozi nk’uko
biteganywa n’itegeko rigenga abatanga
serivizi zo kwishyurana.
Mu gusuzuma niba abagize inama
y’ubutegetsi babikwiriye, ibijyanye
n’ubumenyi n’uburambe bikurikira bigomba
kwitabwaho:
1º serivisi z’imari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga;
2º isesengura ry’ubucuruzi;
3º gutegura raporo z’imari;
4º ikoranabuhanga;
5º igenamigambi;
6º gucunga ibyateza ingorane;
7º amategeko agenga uburyo bwo
kwishyurana n’amabwiriza bijyana;
8º imiyoborere y’ibigo;
9º n’ubushobozi bwo kuyobora.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa mu bijyanye n’amafaranga Ibigo bitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga bibika mu mafaranga
articles.text:
afatika nibura ingano y’ijana ku ijana (100%)
by’imbumbe y’amafaranga abitswe ari mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga.
Ibigo bitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga bigomba kubitsa
amafaranga mu gihe gikwiriye kuri konti
zabyo zihuriweho niba amafaranga
y’imbumbe ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
ari menshi kuruta amafaranga afatika.
Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga kigaragaza mu mategeko
shingiro yacyo interuro zivuga ko amafaranga
ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga y’abakiriya
abitse neza kuri konti ihuriweho kandi ko
atazakoreshwa mu gihe cy’igihombo
cyangwa iseswa ry’ikigo gitanga amafaranga
ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga.
Ibigo bitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga bitakira amafaranga
abitswa , buri munsi, bitarenze saa kumi za
z’umugoroba (16h :00) mu Rwanda, bigomba
kuguza amafaranga bifite n’amafaranga ari
mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga yakwishyurwa
hakurikijwe agaciro k’amafaranga ari mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga y'abakiriya,
intumwa n'abacuruzi baranguza. Umubare
w'amafaranga abura ugomba kuba
wagaragajwe kandi ugakosorwa bitarenze saa
12:00 z'umunsi ukurikiyeho.
Ku byerekeye igenzura, ibigo bitanga amafaranga
ari mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga bigendeye ku
miterere y’inyandiko iteganywa na Banki Nkuru,
bigomba gutanga, buri cyumweru, inyandiko zose
zijyanye n'amafaranga yavuzwe haruguru ndetse
n’uko ikinyuranyo cyavaho buri gihe.
Ihuzwa rivugwa mu gika cya kanecy’iyi
ngingo rigomba kugaragaza umubare
w’amafaranga asigaye kuri konti
y’amafaranga ari mu ikoranabuhanga,
bishyizwe mu byiciro bya konti biteganywa
muri aya mabwiriza rusange.
Iyo ibigo bitanga amafaranga mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga birenze ku bikubiye muri
iyi ngingo bihanwa nk’uko biteganyijwe mu
mabwiriza ashyiraho ibihano by’ubuyobozi
bifatirwa abatanga serivise zo kwishyurana
hamwe n’abakozi bakoresha uburyo bwo
kwishyurana.
Ibigo bitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga bitakira amafaranga
abitswa bigomba kwizeza ko ingano
y’amafaranga abitse afatika nk’uko yavuzwe
mu gika cya mbere cy’iyi ngingo ahora
angana n’imbumbe y’amafaranga abitswe mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga.
Bitabangamiye ibiteganywa n’Amabwiriza
rusange yerekeye ibihano byo mu rwego
rw’ubutegetsi ku bashinzwe uburyo
bw’imyishyuranire n’abatanga serivisi zo
kwishyurana; iyo habonetse ikinyuranyo, aho
imbumbe y’amafaranga abitse mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga aruta ingano
y’amafaranga abitse afatika, ikigo gitanga
amafaranga mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
kitacyira amafaranga abitswa gihanishwa
igihano kingana n’inshuro eshatu
z’ikinyuranyo cyagaragajwe.
Ibigo byakira amafaranga abitswa bikora
ibikorwa bijyanye n’amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga ntibisabwa kubahiriza
ibisabwa bijyanye n’amafaranga biteganywa
mu gika cya mbere cyavuzwe haruguru muri
iyi ngingo, ariko bisabwa kugaragaza
amafaranga yo mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
bifite mu bisabwa byerekeye amafaranga
bizigamye ategetswe n’ibisabwa mu bijyanye
n’amafaranga biteganywa na Banki Nkuru.

articles.heading: Kurinda amafaranga ahuriweho Amafaranga ari kuri konti ihuriweho ntashobora gufatirwa
articles.text:
Amafaranga ari kuri konti ihuriweho
ntashobora mu gihe icyo ari cyo cyose kujya
munsi y’agomba kuba ahari.
Uko byagenda kose amafaranga ahuriweho
ntashobora kuba ingwate.
Mu gihe hagamijwe gutandukanya
amafaranga ahuriweho, ikigo gitanga
amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
kigomba :
1º kumenya neza ko amafaranga yose
yakiriwe abitse kuri konti ihuriweho
cyangwa konti yihariye ;
2º kugenzura neza ko amafaranga abitse
kuri konti ihuriweho cyangwa kuri konti
yihariye adashobora mu buryo ubwo ari
bwo bwose kujya munsi y’ayo kirimo
abakiriya ;
3º kudashyira amafaranga kuri konti
y’ikigo bwite ikoreshwa mu bikorwa
by’ubucuruzi bisanzwe. Ariko mu gihe
ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga gikora
nk’umucuruzi, amafaranga azimurwa
ava kuri konti ihuriweho ashyirwe kuri
konti isanzwe y’ikigo bwite hakurikijwe
ingingo ziteganywa n’aya mabwiriza ;
4º gutanga raporo buri cyumweru muri
Banki Nkuru ku iyimurwa
ry’amafaranga ryavuzwe mu gace ka 3o
k’iki gika ;
5º kutavanga konti ihuriweho n’ibigo
bitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga bitakira amafaranga
abitswa n’amafaranga y’undi muntu
utari mu bafite amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga biba bibabikiye ;
6º no gukoresha uburyo buboneye bwo
gukumira ibyateza ingorane kugira ngo
kigenzure ko amafaranga abitswe kuri
konti ihuriweho yatandukanyijwe
bihagije kandi ko abitse mu kigo
cy’imari cyemejwe na Banki Nkuru.
Banki Nkuru ishobora gushyiraho izindi
ngamba zo kurinda no gutandukanya
amafaranga ahuriweho mu rwego rwo
kurinda konti cyangwa amafaranga
ahuriweho.

articles.heading: Gutandukanya amafaranga ahuriweho mu bigo by’imari Ku nyungu zo gukumira ingaruka ku kigo icyo ari cyo cyose cy’imari cyakira
articles.text:
amafaranga abitswa, ikigo gitanga
amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
kitakira amafaranga abitswa gitandukanya
aho kibitsa amafaranga cyakira kiyagurana
amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
yatanzwe, abitswa kuri konti zafunguwe mu
bigo by’imari bitandukanye hitabwa mu
miterere y’ibyateza ingorane.
Amafaranga ahuriweho ikigo runaka kiba
kibikiye ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kitakira
amafaranga abitswa ntabwo agomba kurenga
makumyabiri ku ijana (20%) by’amafaranga
yose ahuriweho abitswe n’ikigo gitanga
amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
abarwa buri gihe. Iyo bigaragaye ko umubare
ntarengwa wagenwe warenze, ikigo gitanga
amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
kitakira amafaranga abitswa kigomba
gushyira amafaranga arenga mu kindi kigo
cy’imari cyakira amafaranga abitswa.
Ku bijyanye n’ibiteganywa mu gika cya
mbere cy’iyi ngingo, amategeko
n’amabwiriza agenga konti ihuriweho
ategeka ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga gukora isuzuma
/igenzura mu buryo bwihuse kugira ngo
kimenye ko amafaranga arenga yashyizwe
mu kindi kigo cy’imari cyakira amafaranga
abitswa mu gihe umubare ntarengwa
wagenwe urenga. Kugira ngo ibyo bishyirwe
mu bikorwa, ikigo cy’imari cyakira amafanga
abitswa gifite konti ihuriweho cyorohereza
ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga kitakira amafaranga
abitswa kugira uburenganzira kuri izo konti
zihuriweho, kugira ngo kimenye ko imibare
yerekeye konti ihura neza.
Ikigo kibikijwemo amafaranga ahuriweho
kigaragaza mu nyandiko zacyo zerekeye
konti ihuriweho ko ikigo gitanga amafaranga
ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga gifite konti
mu izina ry’abagenerwabikorwa bavuzwe.

articles.heading: Konti ihuriweho na konti yihariye Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga ntigitanga amafaranga
articles.text:
ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kidafunguje
konti ihuriweho cyangwa konti yihariye
hakurikijwe aya mabwiriza rusange.
Hakurikijwe ibiteganywa mu gika cya mbere
cy’iyi ngingo, ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari
mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga giteye nka:
1° ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kitakira
amafaranga abitswa gisabwa gufunguza
no gukomeza gukoresha konti
ihuriweho muri banki cyangwa ikigo
cy’imari iciriritse cyakira amafaranga
abitswa;
2° ikigo cy’imari cyakira amafaranga
abitswa gisabwa gufunguza no
gukomeza gukoresha konti yihariye.
Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga kivugwa mu gace ka
kabiri kavuzwe haruguru:
1° gifunguza konti yihariye ishyirwaho
amafaranga abitswa n’abafite konti
bahawe amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga;
2° kigenzura ko konti ifite inyandiko
zerekeye abakiriya zatanzwe ziherekeje
amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga;
3° kigenzura ko konti yihariye
idashobora guhura n’ingorane zishobora
gutuma abagenerwabikorwa ba nyiri
amafaranga bahura n’igihombo;
4° kandi cyubahiriza ibindi byasabwa na
Banki Nkuru.

articles.heading: Ishyirwaho ry’ubwizerane Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga gishyiraho ubwizerane
articles.text:
mu nyandiko y’imenyekanisha ry’ikigega
cy’ubwizerane ivuga ko:
1° gifite amafaranga ahuriweho mu
izina ry’abagenerwabikorwa;
2° amafaranga ahuriweho acungwa
n’ucunga iby’abandi w’umwuga
hashingiwe ku bubasha ahabwa
n’aya mabwiriza rusange;
3° kubikuza amafaranga ahuriweho
bikorwa gusa nk’uko biteganywa
n’aya mabwiriza rusange.

articles.heading: Ibikubiye mu nyandiko y’imenyekanisha Inyandiko y’imenyekanisha iteganyijwe mu ngingo ya 27 y’aya mabwiriza igomba kuba
Ibigomba kubahirizwa Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kigomba gushyiraho
articles.text:
uburyo buhamye butuma habaho igenzura
rirambuye. Ubu buryo bw'igenzura
bukubiyemo ariko ntibugarukira kuri ibi
bikurikira :
1° inyandiko zuzuye zerekeye konti
z'amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw'ikoranabuhanga zafungujwe ;
2° kugaragaza abafite amafaranga ari mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga ;
3° kwandika umubare uranga igikoresho
kifashishwa mu gukora igikorwa ;
4° guhuza no gukurikirana ibikorwa
by’amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga byakozwe
n’abakiriya b’amafaranga ndetse
n’amafaranga abafite amafaranga ari
mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
basigaranye ;
5° politiki, ingamba, imiterere
y'imiyoborere byerekeye :
i. imicungire y’ibikorwa remezo
by’ikoranabuhanga ;
ii. umutekano n’inozwa
ry’ibikorwa by’amafaranga ari
mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga ;
iii. Imicungire y’abakozi ;
iv. no kurwanya ibikorwa
by’iyezandonke no gutera
inkunga iterabwoba;
6° uburyo bwo gutabaza bwikoresha
n’ibigaragaza ibikorwa bikemangwa.
Ibigo bitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga bigomba kugenzura ko
bifite uburyo bunoze bwo kurinda amakuru
no kubungabunga ukuri kwayo.

articles.heading: Kubika inyandiko Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kigomba kubika neza
Kwemeza na raporo zihariye Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga kigomba gusaba Banki
articles.text:
Nkuru uruhushya rwo gukora ibi bikurikira:
1° impinduka zigaragara zabaye
zerekeye ibisabwa kugira ngo usaba
ahabwe uruhushya;
2° buri hererekanya ry’imigabane
igaragara y’ikigo gitanga amafaranga
ari mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga
gitanga gusa serivisi zo kwishyurana.
Buri kigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga kitakira amafaranga
abitswa gikoresha ubugenzuzi ku bitabo
by’ibaruramari n’uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga
byacyo kandi mu gihe cy’amezi ane akurikira
isoza ry’umwaka w’ingengo y’imari,
gishyikiriza Banki Nkuru ibi bikurikira:
1° kopi ya raporo y’umugenzuzi
w’imari;
2° raporo y’imari yagenzuwe yihariye
kuri konti zihuriweho;
3° raporo y’ubugenzuzi ku bijyanye
n'umutekano mu ikoranabuhanga ku
bikorwa bya serivisi zo kwishyurana
n’ikigo cy’ubugenzuzi cyigenga
cyemewe;
4° andi makuru yasabwa na Banki Nkuru
ku bijyanye na serivisi
z’imyishyuranire zacyo.

articles.heading: Ubufatanye na Banki Nkuru Kugira ngo habeho ubufatanye na Banki Nkuru, buri kigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu
articles.text:
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kigomba
kumenyesha Banki Nkuru:
1° itangira ry’ikirego cy’ingenzi
gitangwa n’ikigo gitanga amafaranga
ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
cyangwa ikirego kiregwa icyo kigo;
2° ibintu byose bifite cyangwa byagira
ingaruka nini ku kigo gitanga
amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga. Muri ibyo bintu
harimo:
i. ibintu bigira ingaruka ku mari
y’ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari
mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga;
ii. ibintu bigira ingaruka kuri
serivisi za buri munsi zitangwa
n’ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari
mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga.
3° ihazabu yose icibwa ikigo gitanga
amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga kiyiciwe n’izindi
nzego zikireberera;
4° cyangwa igenzurwa ry’ikigo gitanga
amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga rikozwe n’izindi
nzego zikireberera.

articles.heading: Imicungire y’ikomeza ry’imirimo Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kigomba
articles.text:
1° kugira ibikorwa remezo binoze kandi
bibika amakuru ;
2° gushyira mu bikorwa gahunda
y’isubukura miromo ni iy’ikomeza
ry’imirimo ;
3° no gusuzuma buri gihe imikorere
inoze y’ibikorwa remezo bibika
amakuru na gahunda igaragaza uko
imirimo ikomeza gukorwa.
Uretse ibiteganyijwe mu gika cya mbere
cy’iyi ngingo, Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari
mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga cyubahiriza
kandi ibisabwa n’amabwiriza rusange agenga
imicungire y’ikomeza ry’imirimo
n’ubudahungabana bwayo mu bigo
bigenzurwa.
UMUTWE WA V: IBYEREKEYE
IMIKORERE

articles.heading: Ibikorwa byemewe n'ibitemewe Uretse itangwa ry’amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga, ibigo bitanga
articles.text:
amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
bitakira amafaranga abitswa byemerewe
gutanga serivisi zo kwishyurana byubahiriza
amabwiriza yashyizweho. Iyo bitanga serivisi
zo kwishyurana, ibigo bitanga amafaranga ari
mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga bishobora
gukora ibikorwa bikurikira:
1° kwishyura amafaranga imbere mu
gihugu;
2° iyakira n’iyohereza ry’amafaranga
mpuzamahanga bikoranye n’abatanga
serivisi zo kuvunja amafaranga
babifitiye uruhushya;
3° ihererekanya ry’amafaranga imbere
mu gihugu, harimo n’amafaranga
aherekanywa akuwe kuri konti kandi
akoherezwa kuri konti iri mu bigo
by’imari;
4° ibikorwa by’imyishyuranire
bitandukanye;
5° ibikorwa byo kubika no kubikuza;
6° ibikorwa by’ihererekaya
ry’amafaranga hatifashishijwe konti
y’amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga;
7° serivisi zo kuzigama hashingiwe ku
masezerano y’imikoranire n’ibigo
by’imari bibyemerewe;
8° serivisi z’inguzanyo hashingiwe ku
masezerano y’imikoranire zitangwa
n’ibigo by’imari byemewe;
9° serivisi z’ubwishingizi hashingiwe ku
masezerano y’imikoranire n’ibigo
by’ubwishingizi byemerewe;
10°ibindi bikorwa cyangwa imirimo
gishobora gusabwa na Banki Nkuru.
Banki Nkuru ibinyujije mu mabwiriza itanga,
ishobora kugabanya ibikorwa byemewe ku
bigo bitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga cyangwa igasubizaho
ibyari bibujijwe iyo ibonye ko bikwiye.

articles.heading: Gutanga no kwisubiza amafaranga Ibigo bitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga bitanga umubare
articles.text:
w’amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga ungana n’umubare
w’amafaranga byakiriye.
Ibigo bitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga bisabwe n’ufite
amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga, byisubiza igihe icyo ari
cyo cyose kandi hakurikijwe umubare,
amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
bifite.
Bitabangamiye ibiteganywa mu gika cya
kabiri cy’iyi ngingo, gusubizwa amafaranga
bishobora kwishyurirwa andi mafaranga iyo
byateganyijwe mu masezerano hagati y’ikigo
gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga n’ufite amafaranga ari
mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga.
Ku byerekeye ibiteganywa n’iyi ngingo, ibigo
bitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga bigenzura buri gihe ko
amafaranga abitswe byisubije akurwa mu
mafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
umunsi igikorwa cyo kuyakura mu kigo
kibikijwemo amafaranga ahuriweho cyabereyeho.

articles.heading: Umubare ntarengwa w’amafaranga yohererezanywa n’abikwa Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
articles.text:
bw’ikoranabuhanga kigomba kumenya ko
amafaranga ya nyiri konti y’amafaranga ari
mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga n’umubare
ntarengwa w’amafaranga yohererezanywa
bijyanye n’impamvu n’ubwinshi
bw’ibikorwa birebana n’imikoreshereze
y’amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga.
Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga kigomba kumenya ko
umutekano uhagije n’ibikorwa by’uburinzi
bishyirwa mu bikorwa kugira ngo hagabanwe
ibyateza ingorane biturutse ku ikoreshwa
ry’umubare ntarengwa w’amafaranga
wagenwe.
Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga kigomba kubanza
kubona inyandiko yemerera itangwa na Banki
Nkuru mu gihe ingano y’amafaranga irenga
miliyoni mirongo itanu z’amafaranga y’u
Rwanda (50.000.000 FRW).

articles.heading: Ihererekanwa ry’amafaranga hatifashishijwe konti y’amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
articles.text:
Ihererekanwa ry’amafaranga hatifashishijwe
konti y’amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga byemerwa gusa
umukiriya amaze kuzuza ibisabwa bikubiye
mu mabwiriza ya Banki Nkuru n’ibindi
bisabwa muri aya mabwiriza rusange.
Ibigo bitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga buri gihe ku bijyanye
n’ibikorwa by’ihererekanywa ry’amafaranga
hatifashishijwe konti y’amafaranga ari mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga bigomba kugira
ahantu hatandukanye bibika nibura amakuru
akurikira yerekeye umukiriya wohereza
amafaranga:
1° izina;
2° nomero ya telefoni na nomero ya konti
y’amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw'ikoranabuhanga ; na
3° nomero y’indangamuntu cyangwa
pasiporo.
Ibigo bitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga buri gihe ku bijyanye
n’ibikorwa by’ihererekanywa ry’amafaranga
hatifashishijwe konti y’amafaranga ari mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga bigomba
kumenyesha ku buryo bwihuse uyakira ko
uwohereza yakoze ihererekanya
ry’amafaranga, kandi uyohereza amenyeshwa
ko amafaranga yakiriwe.

articles.heading: Kubuza inyungu kuri konti ihuriweho Konti ihuriweho na konti bwite y’amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikorarabuhanga
articles.text:
iyishamikiyeho zikoreshwa gusa mu
korohereza kwishyurana. Kubera iyo
mpamvu, konti ihuriweho na konti bwite
y’amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga ntizibyara inyungu,
keretse konti bwite y’amafaranga ari mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga ikoreshwa gusa
nka konti yo kuzigama.

articles.heading: Ibaruramari n’itangazwa ry’amafaranga ahuriweho Buri kigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kigomba kubika
articles.text:
inyandiko na konti bigifasha igihe icyo ari cyo
cyose kandi no mu buryo bwihuse,
gutandukanya amafaranga abikiwe umwe mu
bakoresha amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga n’amafaranga abikiwe
n’undi uwo ari we wese bayakoresha hamwe
n’amafaranga y’ikigo ubwacyo gitanga
amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga.
Kugira ngo habeho gutandukanya neza
amafaranga ahuriweho n’amafaranga y’ikigo
gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga, amafaranga ahuriweho
ntagomba gushyirwa muri raporo z’ibanze
z’amafaranga y’ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari
mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga. Amafaranga
ahuriweho agomba kwerekanwa hepfo kuri
raporo y’imari yerekana imiterere
y’umutungo hamwe no gutangaza mu
nyandiko raporo z’imari.
Gutangaza amafaranga ahuriweho bikurikira
bigomba gukorwa mu nyandiko zerekeye
raporo z’imari:
1º imiterere y’amafaranga ahuriweho ;
2º ibigo by’imari bifite amafaranga
ahuriweho ;
3º raporo z’inyungu zinjiye zose
z’amafaranga ahuriweho ;
4º raporo z’uko umutungo wa konti
ihuriweho uhagaze,
5º n’amafaranga ayo ari yo yose cyangwa
ibindi bihwanywa na yo bibarirwa mu
mafaranga ahuriweho.
Kugira ngo habeho itangazwa rinoze
ry’amafaranga ahuriweho, ikigo gitanga
amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
kigomba gutangaza raporo z’imari za konti
zihuriweho, zagenzuwe mu mezi ane (4)
akurikira irangira ry’umwaka w’ingengo
y’imari nibura muri kimwe mu binyamakuru
bisomwa na benshi no ku rubuga rwacyo rwa
interineti.

articles.heading: Guhwanya ubwishyu Iyo ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kitakira amafaranga
articles.text:
abitswa gifite amafaranga ahuriweho mu kigo
cyakira amafaranga abitswa kirenze kimwe,
ibikorwa by’ihwanyabwishyu byose bikorwa
hashingiwe ku myishyuranire ikorwa hagati
y’amabanki ndetse n’uburyo bwo
kwishyurana bugenwa na Banki Nkuru.

articles.heading: Kumenyekanisha igikorwa Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kimenyesha ku buryo
articles.text:
bwihuse umukiriya wese ukoze igikorwa
cy’amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
igikorwa cyose cyakorewe muri serivisi
y’amafaranga y'ikoranabuhanga.
Haseguriwe ibiteganywa mu gika cya mbere
cy’iyi ngingo, imenyekanisha riba
rigararagaza nibura ibi bikurikira:
1° amafaranga y’igikorwa;
2° ubwoko bw’igikorwa;
3° itariki n’isaha igikorwa cyabereyeho;
4° amafaranga umukiriya acibwa kubera
icyo gikorwa;
5° amakuru yerekeye umwirondoro
w’intumwa aho usabwa;
6° na nomero yihariye iranga igikorwa.
Uburyo bw’ikoranabunga bw’utanga
amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
bugomba guha uwishyuye kuri buri gikorwa
yakoze yishyura ariko ntigikunde, ubutumwa
bugaragaza ko igikorwa cye kitabaye ndetse
n’impamvu yabiteye.
Ikiguzi cyo gukora igikorwa cyose, harimo
n’amabwiriza yerekeye ihererekanya
ry’amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga, haba hifashishijwe
ubutumwa kuri telefoni cyangwa ubundi
buryo muri gahunda y’amafaranga ari mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga, kimenyeshwa
vuba umukiriya mbere y’uko igikorwa
cyemezwa kandi kigaragazwa mu mafaranga
y’u Rwanda.

articles.heading: Ikoranabuhanga rikoreshwa Ikoranabuhanga rikoreshwa muri serivisi z’amafaranga ari mu buryo
articles.text:
bw’ikoranabuhanga rigomba kuba ryizewe
kandi ribika ibanga, ukuri, kandi ryihagije.
Ikoranabuhanga rikoreshwa muri serivisi
z’amafaranga ari mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga, ryubahiriza amabwiriza
rusange yerekeye umutekano
w’ikoranabuhanga mu itangazabumenyi.
UMUTWE WA VI: INGINGO
ZINYURANYE, IZ’INZIBACYUHO
N’IZISOZA

articles.heading: Ingingo y’inzibacyuho Ikigo gitanga amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kitakira amafaranga
articles.text:
abitswa gifite urushya, gishyira mu bikorwa
ibikubiye mu ngingo ya 27 n’iya 28 z’aya
mabwiriza rusange mu gihe cy’umwaka
umwe (1) uhereye igihe aya mabwiriza
atangiriye gukurikizwa.
Impushya z’ibigo bivugwa mu gika cya
mbere cy’iyi ngingo zishobora guhagarikwa
by’agateganyo mu gihe cy’amezi atatu (3),
uhereye igihe cyirangira cy’inzibacyuho
kivugwa mu gika cya mbere cy’iyi ngingo.
Iyo kutubahiriza ibisabwa gukomeje nyuma
y’igihe cyo guhagarikwa by’agateganyo
giteganywa mu gika cya 3 cy’iyi ngingo,
Banki Nkuru ishobora gufata icyemezo cyo
kwambura burundu impushya ibigo
byavuzwe mu gika cya mbere cy’iyi ngingo.

articles.heading: Ibihano byo mu rwego rw’ubuyobozi Utanga amafaranga ari mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga utubahiriza ibivugwa
articles.text:
muri aya mabwiriza ahabwa ibihano byo mu
rwego rw’ubuyobozi biteganyijwe mu
mabwiriza rusange yihariye agenga ibihano
by’ubuyobozi bihabwa abatanga serivisi zo
kwishyurana.

articles.heading: Ivanwaho ry’ingingo zinyuranyije n’aya mabwiriza Amabwiriza n° 08/2016 yo ku wa 01/12/2016 agenga abatanga amafaranga ari mu buryo
articles.text:
bw’ikoranabuhanga n’ingingo zose
z’amabwiriza abanziriza aya kandi
zinyuranyije na yo bivanyweho.

articles.heading: Igihe aya mabwiriza atangira gukurikizwa n’imibereho bwite by’umuntu, cyane mu ngingo zaryo, iya 2, iya 11 n’iya 17 ;
articles.text:
Isubiye ku Mabwiriza n° 08/2016 yo ku wa
01/12/2016 agenga abatanga amafaranga ari
